how.title: How it works
how.lead: Your garment gets a tag with a QR code. Every time someone scans it, you get a message.
how.s1.p: Choose what needs doing. The price shows straight away.
how.s2.p: Leave it at a partner dry cleaner, or ask for a home pickup.

board.title: Prices
board.lead: 28 services, priced for everyday fabric in a normal week. You'll see your exact total before you order.
board.note: In every price: matching thread, standard buttons and zips, saree fall cloth and pressing. Delicate fabric (silk, georgette, chiffon, satin, velvet) costs 30% more. Embellished work costs 50% more and needs a Premium tailor. For bridal wear, leather and full suits, send a photo for a quote.

tier.prem.l1: Everything, even zips, resizing and lined clothes

faq.title: Questions people ask
faq.q1: How do I know what to ask for?
faq.a1: Tap the spot on the garment above. Still not sure? Send us a photo on chat.
faq.a2: Each fix has a set price. Silk and delicate fabric cost 30% more, embellished work 50% more, and festival and wedding weeks 20% more. You see the total before you order.
faq.q3: Do I need to be home?
faq.a3: Not if you drop it at a dry cleaner near you. For home pickup, someone should be there. If we miss you twice, it costs 10% of the order, up to ₹100.
faq.a4: Show us the fit: a measurement, a pin or chalk mark, or a garment that fits. If the work doesn't match, we redo it free within 7 days.
faq.q5: Do you take payment on this site?
faq.a5: Not in this demo. In the real service you pay when you order, and the price is fixed.
help.title: Help
help.lead: Marking your fit, changing plans, and fees.
fit.title: How to mark your fit
fit.lead: A tailor can only match what they can see. Pick one when you order, and the free redo covers the fit too.
fitm.measurement.p: Say how much to take off, like 1.5 inches.
fitm.mark.p: Pin or chalk the new line while you wear it.
fitm.reference.p: Send one that already fits. We'll copy it.
fitm.none.p: Our free redo then covers stitching, not fit.
pol.title: Fees and policies
pol.lead: The price changes only when the job itself changes.
pol.r2.s: Cancel before pickup or counter drop
pol.r3.s: Cancel after pickup, before a tailor is assigned
pol.r3.a: Work refunded, pickup fee kept. Garment comes back on the next delivery.
pol.r6.a: One free retry the same afternoon. Next-day redelivery ₹49.
pol.r7.s: The job is different from what you ordered
pol.r7.a: We send a new price with a photo. Pay the difference, or cancel and get the work refunded. A lower price is refunded automatically.
pol.r8.s: Work doesn't match your order or fit mark
pol.r8.a: Free redo within 7 days, pickup fee waived
pol.r9.a: We pay for it: up to 10× the work price, unless you declared a value.
pol.fine: Home pickup is ₹99 within 4 km and ₹149 for 4–8 km. Free on orders of ₹1,200 or more. We don't go beyond 8 km yet.
